research.question: Blocker 0: Current official Ticimax documentation proves the WebSiparisFiltre and WebSiparisSayfalama member names. Research the remaining public API contract details for SelectSiparis: exact SOAP request wrapper name, exact parameter element names, exact XML namespaces, and namespace qualification of nested filter and pagination elements. Search current official Ticimax documentation, public SiparisServis WSDL/XSD references, and official SelectSiparis SOAP examples.

official_sources.observation: The company website links to www.destekalani.com as its support system, establishing official publication of the support documentation.
Links to SiparisServis.pdf as current documentation and to Ticimax's Azure DevOps C# examples. Contains SOAP examples for other operations, but no SelectSiparis example.

Officially linked current order-service documentation opened successfully. Pages 10–11 describe SelectSiparis parameters and classes; pages 17–18 provide C# usage, without a SOAP envelope or XML namespace declarations.
Ticimax-hosted service documentation, version 1.4, opened successfully. Page 9 explicitly supplies the SelectSiparis method signature and parameter names.

claims.claim: The official version 1.4 documentation names the method SelectSiparis and its method parameters UyeKodu, f, and s. This does not independently establish their current SOAP element names.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/webservis.pdf — page 9 gives SelectSiparis(string UyeKodu, WebSiparisFiltre f, WebSiparisSayfalama s), with a parameter table identifying f as the filter and s as pagination.

claims.claim: The currently linked order-service PDF establishes the operation and argument types, but does not resolve the exact SOAP wrapper or parameter QNames.
claims.evidence: https://static.ticimax.com/dokumanlar/SiparisServis.pdf — page 10 labels parameters UyeKodu, WebSiparisFiltre, and WebSiparisSayfalama; page 18 calls SelectSiparis using three C# arguments. Neither passage specifies serialized XML element names or namespaces.

claims.claim: Official SOAP examples demonstrate namespace-qualified operation parameters and nested members for other operations; applying those namespaces to SelectSiparis would remain an inference.
claims.evidence: https://www.destekalani.com/Icerik/ws-yetki-kodu-yonetimi-web-servis-modulu-649 — the SelectUrun example declares soapenv=http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/, tem=http://tempuri.org/, and ns=http://schemas.datacontract.org/2004/07/. It uses tem:SelectUrun, tem:UyeKodu, tem:f, tem:s, and ns-prefixed nested members. The page contains no SelectSiparis example.

unresolved: Exact current SelectSiparis SOAP request wrapper local name and namespace were not directly verified.
Exact current SOAP parameter element names, casing, and namespaces remain unverified; the documented method parameters UyeKodu, f, and s are insufficient proof of serialization.
Namespace qualification of nested WebSiparisFiltre, EntegrasyonParams, and WebSiparisSayfalama elements remains unverified.

No readable, verified Ticimax-published SelectSiparis WSDL/XSD was obtained. A public reference at https://www.noteshop.com.tr/Servis/SiparisServis.svc?wsdl returned a web-tool internal error; its publication by Ticimax was not established.
No official SelectSiparis SOAP envelope example was located. The officially linked https://dev.azure.com/ticimax/TicimaxWebService/_git/TicimaxWebService page yielded no readable contract source.
research.summary: Live official sources confirm the method signature and provide namespace patterns for other operations, but do not sufficiently prove the requested current SelectSiparis XML contract. The blocker remains unresolved.
